verdict.rationale: The probe evidence shows a real, non-interactive, promptless install using `npx -y skills add obra/superpowers ... -y --copy`, which fetched and installed a skill headlessly end-to-end, and docs confirm plugin-manager install commands (e.g. `/plugin marketplace add`, `devin plugins install obra/superpowers`) that agents/CLIs can run without human prompts. Community evidence notes the install mechanism is 'curl|bash but with added LLM agents,' which is unusual but doesn't contradict that it works headlessly. missing for 10: no independent third-party corroboration of fully unattended install across multiple harnesses beyond the single probe, and no explicit confirmation that all harness install paths (not just Claude Code/Devin) are prompt-free.
